The formula for the derivative of arctangent is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arctan}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\operatorname{arctan}⁡(7{x}^{4})] \\  & =\frac{1}{1+{(7{x}^{4})}^{2}}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(7{x}^{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{1+49{x}^{8}}\cdot 28{x}^{3} \\  & =\frac{28{x}^{3}}{49{x}^{8}+1}.\end{aligned}
$$
